title: Bath and body works scent replacements
text: Bath and body works scent replacements. They were sold out at Bath and Body and I wanted to try this scent.  To be honest, it smells like a slightly less scentful 'Balsam' - I imagined it would smell like a bit of balsam and the manly mahogany scent they've had forever-  I imagined trees and mahogany - but no.  It's not a bad scent but I will just still with the Balsam when I want it. It's really hard to describe scent since everyone has a different idea about what they are smelling.  Sorry about that.  It's not an unpleasant smell to me.  I think you almost have to GO to a bath and body (like I did) and take notes on what you like and don't like.  I have found that when there in person, their scents RARELY met their description!  One of my favorites was a spring mango.  It didn't smell ANYTHING like mango and I would NEVER have chosen it online because I don't like 'mango' anything unless I'm eating it. So, this a good scent, but not one I will repurchase.

product_metadata.title: Bath and Body Works 4 Pack Mahogany Balsam Wallflowers Fragrance Refill 0.8 Oz.
description: Bath and Body Works 4 Pack Mahogany Balsam Wallflowers Fragrance Refill. Includes: 4 Wallflower Fragrance Refill Bulbs (0.8 fl oz each). What it smells like: traipsing through the forest in your favorite wintry ensemble. Fragrance notes: juniper berry, fresh balsam and mahogany wood.
